description: A painterly, dark-toned scene. A gloved hand holds a pipette above a clear plastic multi-well plate, with an amber liquid being dispensed into the wells. Behind it, several blood bags hang from a metal stand on the right, with dark red blood and tubing. A second gloved hand rests at the lower right on the bench. Beakers, test tubes in a rack and glassware sit in the shadowy background. No visible text, frame or border; the painting fills the image edge to edge.
